phenotypes: GS1=golden bud; GS2=golden full bloom; RS1=red-outer-petal bud; RS2=red-outer-petal full bloom
key_metabolite_pattern: alpha-, gamma-, beta-carotene, phytoene/author-reported phytochrome and epsilon-carotene highest in RS1; lycopene higher in RS1/RS2 than GS1/GS2
state_vector_decision: red outer-petal phenotype is accompanied by stronger carotenoid accumulation at matched developmental stages; do not equate visible red with an anthocyanin-only state
claim_ceiling: one within-species colour-variant system; supports a carotenoid dimension of state aliasing, not a genus-wide red-carotenoid rule
